figures.caption: **Figure 1. Pair once, connect every time.** Pairing stores a secret key on both devices. Connecting uses that key each time they meet.
figures.alt: Figure 1. Pair once, connect every time. Pairing stores a secret key on both devices. Connecting uses that key each time they meet.

figures.caption: **Figure 2. One small band, lots of users.** Bluetooth hops between many tiny channels, many times a second. It learns which ones are busy and skips them.
figures.alt: Figure 2. One small band, lots of users. Bluetooth hops between many tiny channels, many times a second. It learns which ones are busy and skips them.

figures.caption: **Figure 3. Bodies get in the way.** Every person between your phone and your earbud weakens the signal. Thicker lines mean a stronger signal.
figures.alt: Figure 3. Bodies get in the way. Every person between your phone and your earbud weakens the signal. Thicker lines mean a stronger signal.

figures.caption: **Figure 4. In a crowd, your earbuds get fewer turns.** Every radio nearby shares the same band, so your earbuds get fewer clear chances. Lime boxes are your earbuds' turns. Not to scale.
figures.alt: Figure 4. In a crowd, your earbuds get fewer turns. Every radio nearby shares the same band, so your earbuds get fewer clear chances. Lime boxes are your earbuds' turns. Not to scale.

figures.caption: **Figure 5. Music goes one way. A call goes both ways.** Lime is sound coming to your ears. Blue is your voice going back to the phone.
figures.alt: Figure 5. Music goes one way. A call goes both ways. Lime is sound coming to your ears. Blue is your voice going back to the phone.

figures.caption: **Figure 6. Two devices at once.** Some earbuds stay connected to a phone and a laptop together. The earbud maker decides which one wins when both make sound.
figures.alt: Figure 6. Two devices at once. Some earbuds stay connected to a phone and a laptop together. The earbud maker decides which one wins when both make sound.

figures.caption: **Figure 7. A short, clear list helps the car find your phone.** Left, the list a car builds up over the years. Right, the same list cleaned up.
figures.alt: Figure 7. A short, clear list helps the car find your phone. Left, the list a car builds up over the years. Right, the same list cleaned up.

figures.caption: **Figure 8. Two radios, two jobs.** Bluetooth finds the car and reconnects. Wi-Fi carries the maps, music and messages to the car's screen.
figures.alt: Figure 8. Two radios, two jobs. Bluetooth finds the car and reconnects. Wi-Fi carries the maps, music and messages to the car's screen.

figures.caption: **Figure 9. Fix the car connection in this order.** Start at the lime box. Stop as soon as it works.
figures.alt: Figure 9. Fix the car connection in this order. Start at the lime box. Stop as soon as it works.

figures.caption: **Figure 10. Pairing again fixes a broken pairing, not a blocked path.** Left, when to forget and pair again. Right, when it won't help.
